title: feat: add OAuth 2.0 protected resource metadata for virtual servers (RFC 9728)
reasoning:
## Summary

Add RFC 9728 OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata and well-known URI endpoints for virtual servers at `/servers/{server_id}/.well-known/*`.

### Endpoints Added

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `GET /servers/{server_id}/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource` | RFC 9728 OAuth metadata |
| `GET /servers/{server_id}/.well-known/robots.txt` | Robot exclusion |
| `GET /servers/{server_id}/.well-known/security.txt` | Security contact info |
| `GET /servers/{server_id}/.well-known/ai.txt` | AI usage policies |
| `GET /servers/{server_id}/.well-known/dnt-policy.txt` | Do Not Track policy |

### Changes

- **New file:** `mcpgateway/routers/server_well_known.py` - Virtual server well-known router
- **Modified:** `mcpgateway/routers/well_known.py` - Extracted shared helper functions
- **Modified:** `mcpgateway/main.py` - Added router import/include
- **New file:** `tests/e2e/test_oauth_protected_resource.py` - 14 E2E test scenarios

### Security

- Only public,
